# inngest_app (Data Source)

Reads one Inngest app: its sync status, SDK, function count and whether it is archived. Apps are created by syncing them from their code, not through Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fail the run when the billing app's latest sync is not healthy.
data "inngest_app" "billing" {
  environment = "production"
  id          = "billing"
}

check "billing_app_synced" {
  assert {
    condition     = try(data.inngest_app.billing.latest_sync.status, "") != "error"
    error_message = "The billing app's latest Inngest sync failed: ${try(data.inngest_app.billing.latest_sync.error, "")}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The user-defined app ID (the `id` passed to the Inngest client in the app's code).

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Environment of the app, sent as the `X-Inngest-Env` header. Defaults to the provider's `environment`, then to `production`.

### Read-Only

- `app_version` (String) User-defined app version, if set.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the app is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) When the app was archived (RFC 3339), if it is.
- `created_at` (String) When the app was first synced (RFC 3339).
- `function_count` (Number) Number of functions in the app.
- `latest_sync` (Attributes) The latest sync of the app, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--latest_sync))
- `method` (String) How the app connects: `UNSPECIFIED`, `SERVE`, `CONNECT`, `API` or `INNGEST_SERVE`.
- `name` (String) App name.

<a id="nestedatt--latest_sync"></a>
### Nested Schema for `latest_sync`

Read-Only:

- `app_version` (String) App version reported by the sync.
- `error` (String) Most recent sync or connection error, if any.
- `framework` (String) Framework reported by the SDK, such as `nextjs`.
- `sdk_language` (String) Language of the SDK, such as `typescript`.
- `sdk_version` (String) Version of the SDK.
- `status` (String) Sync status: `pending`, `success`, `error` or `duplicate`.
- `synced_at` (String) Time of the sync (RFC 3339).
- `url` (String) URL of the app's Inngest endpoint, if synced by URL.
